title: HRgene paired testbeds: a cue-confounded and a de-confounded testbed for LLM output repair
description: Two synthetic hiring-review testbeds for one task (an original testbed in which every planted unsupported claim sits in a note-type source, and a de-confounded testbed in which planted content is spread over notes, resume entries and work samples), the HRgene validation-and-repair pipeline, recorded outputs of three open-weight models, the pre-registered analysis plan and manifest of the second study (https://osf.io/8vejq), and all analysis code. Accompanies the paper 'Rethinking Synthetic Testbeds for LLM Output Repair: A Construction Cue and a Pre-registered De-confounded Test'. Data are licensed under CC BY 4.0; code is licensed under the MIT licence. All cases are fictional and were drafted by LLM agents without case-level human review; the testbeds must not be used to rank or select real candidates.
